correctness.rationale: Read the exact cubic F=w²b+a²c+b³+c³+d³ and cover z²+bc=0 in the actual RESULT.md. Gradient of F has no nonzero projective common zero; branch b=0 and c=0 are cones over smooth plane elliptic cubics, with scheme intersection b=c=d³=0 on a supported line. The double cover is nonsquare in C(X), complete intersection S2 with singular set the line (codimension two), hence integral normal by R1+S2. Adjunction on a (2,3) CI in P5 gives −K=O(1), degree6. Independently substituted the displayed rational inverse (t=z/c,v=d/c,s=c/(a−t), B=1−t⁶+v³, D=1+Bs², a=t(Bs²−1)/D,c=−2ts/D,b=−t²c,d=vc,z=tc) into both defining equations and recovered inverse parameters exactly. On generic transverse slices wa≠0 two smooth branch curves meet to order3 and the cover has UV=v^6 (A5); at the two endpoints slices yield z²=u(u³+v³), four distinct binary quartic roots, I=0 and j=0 simple elliptic E7. These are transverse surface germs, not threefold canonical singularities. Inspected supplied symbolic verifier, independently tested substitutions; no global classification of all threefold germs claimed.
